---
title: "Country Analysis - China"
---

This page analyses changes in life expectancy, GDP per capita, and population over time for China.

## Life Expectancy

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
gap <- read.csv("gapminder.csv")
country_data <- subset(gap, country=="China")
ggplot(country_data, aes(x=year, y=life_expectancy)) +
  geom_line(color="steelblue", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(color="steelblue") +
  labs(title="Life Expectancy Over Time", x="Year", y="Life Expectancy") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## GDP Per Capita

```{r}
ggplot(country_data, aes(x=year, y=gdp_per_capita)) +
  geom_line(color="darkgreen", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(color="darkgreen") +
  labs(title="GDP per Capita Over Time", x="Year", y="GDP per Capita") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Population

```{r}
ggplot(country_data, aes(x=year, y=population_millions)) +
  geom_line(color="orange", size=1.2) +
  geom_point(color="orange") +
  labs(title="Population Over Time", x="Year", y="Population (millions)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
